source_review.notes: Checked seven primary or official sources. Google AIP-180 catalogs backward-compatibility concerns within Google-style APIs. RFC 9413 analyzes risks of applying the robustness principle too broadly and supports bounded, explicit extensibility rather than arbitrary acceptance. Protocol Buffers documents wire-safe, wire-unsafe, and conditionally safe updates. The September 2025 GraphQL specification provides current schema/type-system evolution context. RFC 9745 defines HTTP deprecation signaling without changing behavior by itself. Kubernetes publishes explicit API deprecation/removal policy as an ecosystem example. Current OpenAPI 3.2.0 defines a machine-readable HTTP interface description. Ecosystem-specific guarantees and support periods are not generalized.

pedagogical_review.notes: The module begins from the coexistence matrix, develops each contract/state/rollout mechanism, and closes with evidence-based contraction. It distinguishes independent deployment from uncoordinated semantics and structural compatibility from behavior throughout. Ten examples and five integrative exercises have complete answers.
